sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)

literature_notes: All five ledger lines (L1–L5) describe FLAG or Strep-HA tags on full-length hMCT9/SLC16A9, but none states a residue number or loop for the insertion. L1–L4 use the construct name 'hMCT9-FLAG', which by convention implies a C-terminal tag; the C-terminus (residues 484–509) is intracellular per the computed topology. L5 states 'C- or N-terminal' Strep-HA; both the N-terminus (residues 1–10) and C-terminus (484–509) are intracellular. No ledger line pins any tag to an extracellular loop or extracellular face of this protein. The rules explicitly exclude any tag whose position is unstated from being pinned as a surface site, and topology-derived assignment is only permitted when exactly one terminus is extracellular — here neither is. Accordingly, zero surface tag sites are reported.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal FLAG tag on hMCT9-FLAG detected by anti-FLAG western blot at 56 kDa in HEK293 cells; C-terminus (484–509) is intracellular per computed topology, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
N-terminal Strep-HA tag on SLC16A9 reported in L5; N-terminus (residues 1–10) is intracellular per computed topology, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
